instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: The prefix mis- adds which idea?
questions.explanation: Mis- adds the idea of doing something in the wrong way or badly.
questions.explanation_ar: البادئة mis- تضيف معنى الأداء بصورة خاطئة أو سيئة.

questions.question: If you mispronounce a word, you...
questions.explanation: Mis- plus pronounce means to produce the sound of the word wrongly.
questions.explanation_ar: mis- مع pronounce تعني إخراج صوت الكلمة بصورة خاطئة.

questions.question: What idea does extra- add?
questions.explanation: Extra- marks something outside or beyond the usual range.
questions.explanation_ar: البادئة extra- تدل على شيء خارج النطاق المعتاد أو أبعد منه.

questions.question: Extracurricular activities are...
options: part of the final written exam
options_en: part of the final written exam
questions.explanation: Extra- plus curricular means outside the normal course of study.
questions.explanation_ar: extra- مع curricular تعني خارج المنهج الدراسي المعتاد.

questions.question: The prefix inter- carries which meaning?
questions.explanation: Inter- signals a relation between two or more things.
questions.explanation_ar: البادئة inter- تدل على علاقة بين شيئين أو أكثر.

questions.question: If two systems are interconnected, they are...
questions.explanation: Inter- plus connected means the parts are linked together.
questions.explanation_ar: inter- مع connected تعني أن الأجزاء مرتبطة ببعضها.

questions.question: The prefix anti- expresses...
questions.explanation: Anti- expresses opposition or resistance to what follows.
questions.explanation_ar: البادئة anti- تعبّر عن المعارضة أو المقاومة لما بعدها.

questions.question: To coexist means to...
questions.explanation: Co- plus exist means to exist together in the same place or time.
questions.explanation_ar: co- مع exist تعني الوجود معاً في المكان أو الزمان نفسه.

questions.question: A midterm exam comes...
options: in the middle of the term
at the end of the term
options_en: in the middle of the term
at the end of the term
questions.explanation: Mid- plus term places the exam in the middle of the study period.
questions.explanation_ar: mid- مع term تضع الاختبار في منتصف الفصل الدراسي.

questions.question: Which suffix turns a noun into an adjective?
questions.explanation: The suffix -ful adds the meaning full of, forming an adjective such as peaceful.
questions.explanation_ar: اللاحقة -ful تضيف معنى مليء بـ، فتكوّن صفة مثل peaceful.

questions.question: Which suffix usually forms a noun?
questions.explanation: The suffix -tion turns a verb such as contribute into the noun contribution.
questions.explanation_ar: اللاحقة -tion تحوّل الفعل contribute إلى الاسم contribution.

questions.question: What part of speech is 'resilient'?
questions.explanation: The ending -ent here marks an adjective that describes a person or thing.
questions.explanation_ar: النهاية -ent هنا تدل على صفة تصف شخصاً أو شيئاً.
